title: Existence of an inner product PCPP description
statement: For every natural number $m$, either $m=0$ and no Boolean word of length $2m$ has inner product modulo two equal to $1$, or $m+m$ is positive and there exists a PCPP description for the Boolean words of length $2m$ whose inner product modulo two is $1$.
